The natural habit of the conditioned ego is to panic, resist, or frantically search for a technique to control present reality. In *In Simple Terms: 108 Dhamma Similes* (Your Real Home), the master directly addresses this core reality with unwavering precision: *"… As long as you don’t see the dangers of these things enough to let them go, don’t see the rewards that will come when you do, your work won’t achieve any purpose.
